credential_data_classification_label.title: Credential Data Classification Label
credential_data_classification_label.description: The formal sensitivity classification label assigned to VPN authentication credential data (usernames, passwords, pre-shared keys, certificates, tokens) within the organization's data classification policy.

classification_enforced_in_handling_poli.title: Classification Enforced in Downstream Handling Policies
classification_enforced_in_handling_poli.description: Indicates whether the assigned classification label is actively referenced and enforced by downstream handling policies, including encryption requirements, retention limits, access controls, and log aggregator configurations for VPN credential data.

log_aggregator_sensitivity_tier.title: Log Aggregator Sensitivity Tier for VPN Auth Events
log_aggregator_sensitivity_tier.description: The sensitivity tier under which VPN authentication events (which may contain credential artifacts) are ingested and stored by the log aggregator or SIEM, reflecting whether protective controls match credential data sensitivity.

credential_fields_in_logs.title: Credential Fields Present in Logs
credential_fields_in_logs.description: Indicates whether VPN authentication credential fields (usernames, passwords, pre-shared keys, tokens) have been observed written in plaintext to system logs, SIEM feeds, or diagnostic traces.

log_credential_masking_enabled.title: Log Credential Masking Enabled
log_credential_masking_enabled.description: Indicates whether the VPN system or logging pipeline has credential masking, redaction, or sanitization controls enabled that prevent plaintext credential values from being written to logs or audit records. Covers both operational logs and audit records.

log_storage_encryption_at_rest.title: Log Storage Encrypted at Rest
log_storage_encryption_at_rest.description: Indicates whether the log storage tier where VPN authentication logs are persisted enforces encryption at rest, protecting any inadvertently captured credential material.

audit_log_sharing_scope.title: Audit Log Sharing Scope
audit_log_sharing_scope.description: Describes how broadly VPN authentication audit records are shared or transmitted — whether kept internal with strict controls, sent to internal SIEM, or forwarded to external/third-party systems.

unmasked_credential_fields_present.title: Unmasked Credential Fields Found in Audit Records
unmasked_credential_fields_present.description: List of credential field types observed in plaintext within audit or accounting records (e.g., 'password', 'otp_value', 'pre_shared_key', 'certificate_serial').

artifact_retention_policy_defined.title: Authentication Artifact Retention Policy Defined
artifact_retention_policy_defined.description: Whether a formal retention policy exists specifying the maximum duration that VPN session tokens, negotiated keys, and hashed credential material may be persisted after session termination.

artifact_max_retention_hours.title: Maximum Artifact Retention Window (Hours)
artifact_max_retention_hours.description: The configured or observed maximum number of hours that authentication artifacts (session tokens, negotiated keys, credential hashes) are retained after session termination. Set to 0 if no retention occurs, or to a very large value (e.g., 8760 for 1 year) if artifacts are retained indefinitely or the value is unknown.

credential_artifacts_persist_to_disk.title: Credential Artifacts Written to Persistent Storage
credential_artifacts_persist_to_disk.description: Whether VPN authentication artifacts (session tokens, derived keys, password hashes, cached credentials) are written to persistent disk storage rather than being held exclusively in volatile memory during session lifetime.

vpn_auth_data_logged_to_external_siem.title: VPN Authentication Data Logged to External SIEM
vpn_auth_data_logged_to_external_siem.description: Whether VPN authentication events (including credential-linked records such as usernames, session tokens, or certificate identifiers) are replicated to an external log aggregation or SIEM platform outside the organization's primary jurisdiction.

data_transfer_legal_mechanism.title: Data Transfer Legal Mechanism
data_transfer_legal_mechanism.description: The legal basis governing the cross-border transfer of personal authentication data to the external SIEM or log platform.

auth_data_anonymization_before_export.title: Authentication Data Anonymized Before Export
auth_data_anonymization_before_export.description: Whether credential-linked fields (usernames, certificate subjects, tokens) are irreversibly anonymized or pseudonymized before being forwarded to the external SIEM platform, reducing regulatory exposure.

secure_credential_disposal_enforced.title: Secure Credential Disposal Enforced
secure_credential_disposal_enforced.description: Indicates whether a formal disposal procedure exists to cryptographically erase or securely overwrite cached authentication material (session keys, PSKs, credential caches) upon session termination or system shutdown. Also covers whether swap space and hibernation files are encrypted or disabled to prevent credential artifact recovery.

credential_cache_persistence_scope.title: Credential Cache Persistence Scope
credential_cache_persistence_scope.description: Describes where authentication material is cached during and after VPN session negotiation — whether it remains only in volatile memory, is written to disk transiently, or is retained in persistent storage beyond session termination.

session_termination_wipe_verified.title: Session Termination Wipe Verified
session_termination_wipe_verified.description: Whether the secure overwriting of cached credential material upon session termination has been independently verified (e.g., through forensic testing, audit, or automated post-termination checks confirming artifact removal).
